description: This file defines the GreengrassClient class for AWS SDK, providing methods to interact with AWS Greengrass service, including creating, deleting, and managing Greengrass resources.

classes.name: GreengrassClient
classes.description: Client class for AWS Greengrass service, extending AwsClient and providing methods for Greengrass resource management.

methods.name: associateRoleToGroup
methods.description: Associates a role to a Greengrass group.

methods.name: associateRoleToGroupAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously associates a role to a Greengrass group.

methods.name: createConnectorDefinition
methods.description: Creates a new connector definition in Greengrass.

methods.name: createConnectorDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new connector definition.

methods.name: getDeploymentStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a deployment.
